If it doesn’t work out for you, you generally have these options:

Return within 30 days: All customers have a voluntary 30-day return right from receipt, as long as items are unused, complete, and in original packaging. Register via the 👉 Return Portal.
Legal 14-day withdrawal (EU/UK): Register your return within 14 days; then you have another 14 days to hand it to the carrier.
Exchange via new order: Direct exchanges aren’t possible. Instead, register a return, send the item back, and place a new order.
After 30 days: In individual cases, we may make an exception if the item is completely unused and in original packaging. In that situation, please contact our Customer Care Team via the 👉 contact form.
Order already placed: Orders can’t be changed or cancelled once placed. If it has already been delivered, you can still register a return via the Return Portal.
